sentences.text:
Jitendra Yadav .... .... Petitioner/Applicant Versus The State of Jharkhand .... .... Opposite Party
----
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJESH KUMAR ----

For the Petitioner/Applicant : Mr. B.M. Tripathi, Sr. Adv.
 For the State : Mr. P.D. Agrawal, A.P.P.
 ----
 th  02/
Heard learned senior counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for the State.

2. The applicant who is in custody since 20.09.2022 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Senha P.S. Case No.36 of 2013 corresponding to G.R. Case No.181 of 2013 (S.T. Case No.152 of 2022), registered for the offence under Sections 376 and 511 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. From perusal of the FIR, it appears that the applicant had thrashed the girl and tried to commit rape.

The incident is of the year 2013 but charge has been framed on 24.11.2022.
4.

It has been submitted by the learned senior counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of FIR along with its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his part.
5.
Innocence has been claimed by the learned senior counsel for the applicant and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

7. Considering the above facts, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-I, Lohardaga in connection with Senha P.S. Case No.36 of 2013 corresponding to G.R. Case No.181 of 2013 (S.T. Case No.152 of 2022), subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Amar/-
